title: Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #84 March 1986 Comic Book - Dave Sim - ISSN 0712-7774
descriptionText: The Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #84 March 1986 comic book, written and illustrated by Dave Sim, is a vintage collectible from the Copper Age of US Comics. This issue features the character Cerebus in a comic book format, published by Aardvark-Vanaheim. With its unique storyline and artistic style, this comic book is a must-have for fans of the genre and collectors of vintage comics.
